causal_reading: HNEK is not a monotone early-positive/late-negative schedule: its sign changes repeatedly through 12000 updates.
A fixed residual exponent is always active and cannot return to the native endpoint law when its physical defect is absent.
DCUM is not a safe repair: it turns negative alone by 1200 and amplifies the HNEK full-view 4000-step failure from -0.7124 to -2.5065 dB.
AEB is a negative control showing that unconditional removal of all odd-latent endpoint variation is too strong.
The next admissible construction should retain the endpoint mean, constrain only physically excessive stochastic variation, and self-null per state rather than per training window.
